notes.title: Update #2: Mandelbrot Zoom & Bug Fixes + 25% off sale!
notes.content:
Fractaltopia just now had its 2nd update! This update features the new Mandelbrot Set Zoom, as well as bug fixes. Not only that, but there will be a 25% off sale. It has never been a better time to pick up Fractaltopia! 

The Mandelbrot Set Zoom feature will include your iteration count, fps, and zoom multiplier. You are able to increase/decrease iterations and zoom up to 50,000x.

If you haven't already, head over to the Singularity Horizons discord where you can suggest new features, report bugs, and keep up to date on the latest progress notes.

http://www.discord.gg/vNVtGGEwcG

25% off sale (Apr 27 10:00am PST - May 3 10:00 PST)
